FN-36IBVEV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 196
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Rep. Reed Ingram
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/27/2024
House Bill 196 as introduced would allow the Land Commissioner to contract with online
auction companies to sell certain tax-delinquent property in the state's inventory, which could
increase receipts to the State General Fund, the respective county general fund, and
municipality, if applicable, by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of proceeds
received from properties sold.
